name: BlastLine
summary: Dual-wield pump shotguns and hold the line in a claustrophobic industrial arena. BlastLine is a fast-paced VR wave shooter built for point-blank combat — pump, fire, and send raiders flying with physics-driven knockback and ragdoll impacts. Survive escalating enemy waves, chain combo kills, chase point-blank bonuses, and push your score before the arena breaks you. Simple to pick up. Brutal to master. Built for players who want raw shotgun power, not cover camping.
